remainingGaps: The 14 operation kinds are visible in a typed non-certifying envelope, but the envelope is not yet bound to one canonical proposal-history state for every operation.
Cross-producer execution, authoritative reread, undo/redo, stale/timeout recovery, and commit evidence remain distributed across bounded slices.
Broader recovery/cleanup remains separately gated and cannot be inferred from the packaged metadata summary.
Technical Builder/repository and active-GM/Foundry authority remain distinct boundaries.
reconciliation.smallestRemainingGap: A typed, read-only proposal-history binding for each existing operation-envelope entry that reports current history-state coverage without executing, approving, persisting, recovering, or adding authority.

decision.reason: M616 preserves the M615 packaged typed-envelope pass and its activation recovery. Direct visibility remains non-certifying and read-only; it does not prove a canonical operation-to-proposal-history binding or the distributed cross-producer lifecycle, recovery, commit, and authority evidence required for Stage 11 acceptance.

selectedNextBoundary.title: Stage 11 typed operation-to-proposal-history evidence binding implementation
selectedNextBoundary.scope: Add only a typed, read-only, non-certifying metadata binding from each existing exact 14-operation envelope entry to the existing proposal-history states and explicit coverage gap. Add focused deterministic/static coverage. Preserve all operation handlers, approval/apply/persistence/recovery/Foundry/provider/session/project/player-password boundaries. No generic executor or new authority. No build, launch, capture, UI action, Stage 11 acceptance, or Stage 12 work is authorized in M617.
